name: Reaper Farm rfDAI vault redeem without owner authorisation
summary: ReaperVaultV2 redeem(shares, receiver, owner) never verifies that the caller is owner or has the owner's share allowance, so the attacker burned arbitrary holders' rfDAI shares and sent the underlying DAI to its receiver.
notes: Plain ReaperVaultV2 deployment; the 16,821-byte runtime is unchanged from creation through the exploit.
Two attacker transactions emitted six Withdraw events whose assets sum to exactly 465,578.315235863858364449 DAI, valued at stablecoin par.
